name: Dune Scorpion
flavour: Half a boss. All of the attitude.
art_prompt: a huge realistic desert scorpion monster with a glossy segmented golden-yellow and amber armoured exoskeleton, two big heavy pincers held forward and open, eight jointed legs, a thick segmented tail curling up high over its back ending in a sharp dark stinger, a small flat head with tiny black bead eyes and small mandibles, no human face, no eyebrows, no grin, no mouth, no teeth, a real scorpion's anatomy, menacing
motion: scuttling in place on its eight legs like a real scorpion, pincers held forward and open, the tail swaying above its back

view_hints.side: the scorpion stays low and horizontal on its eight legs like a real scorpion seen from the side, body parallel to the ground, both pincers reaching forward to the right, the segmented tail curling up and over its back with the stinger above its head, never standing upright on two legs
view_hints.bd: low on its eight legs, tail curled over its back, pincers ahead of it
view_hints.fd: low on its eight legs, tail curled over its back, pincers ahead of it

doc: The Elite that fights up close: it charges down a red line, and between charges it sinks into the sand and bursts up under the hero's feet (throwing him and the crowd a little), slamming his spot with its tail and spitting a short fan of three barbs. Everything it does throws him.
anim_negative: a human face, eyebrows, a grin, teeth, standing upright, extra tails, extra pincers, legs merging
dead_hint: lying flat on its back on the ground, dead: its eight legs curled up limp in the air, the pincers open and limp, the tail stretched out flat on the ground

SC-0.note: Pass 45: painted from the 2D reference (Wan clips; extra tails crept in)

SC-A.note: Golden amber (today's colours on the 3D model's anatomy)
